description: A detailed narrative prompt for a video scene where Odysseus returns to Ithaca and meets his dying dog, Argos.
promptText: Odysseus returns to Ithaca after twenty years, disguised as a beggar. As he approaches his palace, he meets his old dog Argos, abandoned and dying on a pile of dung. Argos recognizes him at once, weakly wags his tail, then dies. Odysseus looks away to hide his tears and keep his identity secret.

title: Anime Space Battleship Combat Scene
description: A detailed cinematic anime-style prompt for a massive silver spaceship engaged in a climactic battle within a starry space environment.
promptText: Final battle scene of the space battleship Kyoshi, anime style, high detail. Against the backdrop of vast space, a huge silver space battleship "Kyoshi" is seen from a diagonal overhead angle. The battleship has a heavy form reminiscent of the Yamato class, with the golden character "Kyo" shining on the bow. In the front left, a silver high-speed assault boat crashes into the enemy flagship, creating an explosion of light. Right next to it, a red energy body transformed into a horse fires a beam that pierces the enemy ship. The enemy fleet is already on fire, with debris scattering in space. title: Dark Angel Over Murky Ocean
description: A dramatic video prompt featuring a dark angel flying low over crashing waves with realistic water reflections.
promptText: A dark angel flies low over a murky ocean in the early morning light. Its reflection bouncing off the water in between the crashing waves.

title: Watch Face Zoom Transition
description: A sophisticated prompt using two reference images to create a professional zoom transition from a person holding a watch to the watch face.
promptText: Take the picture of me holding the watch and make a video where the camera zooms in to the watch face and you see the image of the watch face in the second picture.

title: Cyclops Cave Firelight Sequence
description: A cinematic video prompt describing a slow dolly movement through a smoky, firelit cavern with a heavy, ancient atmosphere.
promptText: Slow dolly-in through thick smoke and flickering firelight into the vast cavernous Cyclops cave. Embers drift past the camera. The shot moves deeper past rough rock walls toward the glowing central fire. Heavy, ancient, tense atmosphere. No dialogue.
